summary: Completed full testing of Clients (Module 2) and Sites (Module 3) features. Found and fixed a critical routing bug where /clients/new and /sites/new explicit routes prevented the create forms from working. All 43 backend tests pass. All frontend flows (create, view, edit, delete, filter, search) working after fix.

integration_issues.issue: After creating a client/site and being redirected to the detail page, the page stays in edit mode instead of view mode. This is because React Router reuses the same component instance (ClientDetail/SiteDetail), keeping isEditing=true from the create state. Minor UX issue - user can click Cancel to switch to view mode.

bugs_fixed.issue: Critical routing bug: explicit routes <Route path="/clients/new" /> and <Route path="/sites/new" /> were matching before <Route path="/clients/:id" />, causing useParams() to return {} (no id param). This made isCreate = undefined === 'new' = false, which triggered a fetch of /clients/undefined (404) and immediately redirected back to /clients.
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed the explicit /clients/new and /sites/new routes. The :id routes now match these URLs with id='new', allowing isCreate = id === 'new' = true to work correctly.

action_items: Consider adding key={id} to ClientDetail and SiteDetail in App.js routes to force component remount on navigation (fixes the 'stays in edit mode after create' UX issue)
The 'CTR-TEST-001' contract visible in Contracts tab appears to be leftover test data - may need cleanup if it causes confusion in production

employees.js router has a similar explicit /employees/new route but it maps to EmployeeCreate (separate component) so it works correctly

rca_of_issue.bug: Create client/site forms immediately redirected to list
rca_of_issue.root_cause: React Router v6 score-based matching: static segments score higher than dynamic params. Route '/clients/new' (2 static) scored higher than '/clients/:id' (1 static + 1 dynamic). When /clients/new matched, useParams() returned {} so id=undefined. Then isCreate = undefined === 'new' = false. Loading state triggered API call to /clients/undefined which 404'd and navigate('/clients') was called.
rca_of_issue.fix: Remove explicit /clients/new and /sites/new routes from App.js. Let /clients/:id match all paths including /clients/new, giving id='new' which makes isCreate=true.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Navigate to /clients/new before fix → immediately redirects to /clients list
